audited_source.factorization: 6 templates x 3 base states x 6 S3 mappings x 6 display orders x 2 query polarities x 3 proof topologies x 3 focus positions

swarm_finding.bug: The in-generator nuisance-only decoder includes base_state_class even though that field is explicitly EXCLUDED_FROM_MODEL_INPUT, while omitting the realized S3 mapping/codebook identity even though the mapping is model-visible.
swarm_finding.why_it_matters: A nuisance-only gate must be computed from the actual rendered model-visible nonsemantic surface. Hidden audit metadata cannot establish absence of a visible shortcut.
swarm_finding.relation_to_prior_negative_evidence: Earlier v1/v2/v3 audits showed that zero marginal balance and pseudo-randomization can coexist with strong higher-order shortcuts. Therefore the proof object must be the realized model-visible projection, not a convenient metadata subset.

corrected_discriminator.method: Mask only R1/R2/R3 semantic payload text in the rendered prompt while preserving codebook mapping/order, proof topology, focus route, query polarity, template-specific atom pool and serialization. Group identical ablated prompts and inspect the target distribution.
corrected_discriminator.required_invariant: Every ablated model-visible nuisance key must retain all three episode-local target symbols with equal counts; exact nuisance-only lookup accuracy must therefore equal 1/3.
corrected_discriminator.deterministic_formula_simulation_scope: Exact v2.2 factorial indices and target algebra reproduced; this is not an admitted EntityOS/HCU runtime execution.

design: derive ablated nuisance keys only from rendered prompt bytes
never consume hidden base_state_class/audit_semantic_class/s3 ids as evidence of independence
preserve visible codebook mapping/order and proof/query routing during semantic ablation
fail if any ablated nuisance group loses three-target support or becomes target-imbalanced
fail if ablated exact-lookup accuracy exceeds 1/3
regression-test a deliberately injected visible target hint
regression-test that hidden audit metadata mutation cannot change the gate result

training_data_update.next_curriculum_extension_after_gate: Only after exact serialized-row gate passes, extend proof depth/distractors and variable-N architecture families without breaking the same nuisance-independence invariant.
